purpose: Minimal MuSiQue-shaped validation fixture for ingestion and validation tests.

expected_cases.notes: Two-hop question with one distractor paragraph and two supporting paragraphs.
The same entity appears under a variant name or alias, which the resolver must handle conservatively.
Valid record with no usable answer path; useful for reflection and grounded-answer validation.
Malformed JSON should fail while parsing.
Valid JSON but missing required MuSiQue structure or required metadata.
Two paragraphs share the same index; valid unique paragraphs may continue while the duplicate is dead-lettered.

notes: This fixture intentionally keeps the data set small and deterministic.
It is designed to be used before the full MuSiQue dataset is loaded or to validate local logic without external API calls.
